title: Bessent and China's He Lifeng Hold 'Successful' Pre-Summit Talks in New York on AI, Tariffs and Rare Earths
detail: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer met Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng at JPMorgan Chase's Manhattan headquarters for day-long talks Bessent called 'successful,' aimed at teeing up agreements ahead of the September 24 Trump-Xi summit in Washington. The agenda covered artificial intelligence, flows of Chinese rare-earth magnets and critical minerals that US officials say remain insufficient, and the status of the US-China trade truce — specifically Washington's suspension of heightened reciprocal tariffs, which is set to expire November 10. Bessent proposed a bilateral notification mechanism for AI safety incidents. The talks came as China's August export surge (+25% YoY to a record $119B trade surplus, per NBS data) gave Beijing a stronger negotiating hand heading into the summit than it had earlier in the year.
